name: propose-lead-reads
why: orchestrate-issues' own policy, reads and issue writes, from the lead a person started.

statements: allow read on anything in repository $primary.repo
allow create on issue in repository $primary.repo
allow create on comment within issue in repository $primary.repo
deny push, merge, close on anything in anywhere
deny retitle on issue in anywhere
deny delete on comment in anywhere
deny read on secret in anywhere

definitions.close: close a pull request or issue without merging it
definitions.comment: a comment or review reply on a pull request or issue
definitions.merge: merge a pull request into its base
definitions.push: add commits to a branch, or move it with --force-with-lease
definitions.retitle: change an issue's title or body
definitions.secret: an Actions, Dependabot or environment secret

statements: allow merge on pull request in repository $primary.repo

definitions.merge: merge a pull request into its base

statements: allow push on branch "main" in repository $primary.repo

definitions.branch: a git branch in a repository
definitions.push: add commits to a branch, or move it with --force-with-lease
